title: Spook SEO
description: Free SEO tools + the Spook SEO autopilot: analyze domains, generate and publish SEO articles.
summary: Free SEO tools + the Spook SEO autopilot: analyze domains, generate and publish SEO articles.
offersHint: Free SEO tools + the Spook SEO autopilot: analyze domains, generate and publish SEO articles. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.tryspook.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: serp-preview
toolsPreview.description: Preview how a page's title and meta description render in Google search, with pixel-width truncation for desktop and mobile.

toolsPreview.name: meta-tag-generator
toolsPreview.description: Generate a complete set of HTML meta tags: title, description, canonical, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards.

toolsPreview.name: schema-generator
toolsPreview.description: Build valid JSON-LD structured data (FAQ, Article, Organization, or Product) for rich results.

toolsPreview.name: robots-txt-generator
toolsPreview.description: Build a valid robots.txt: allow or block crawlers, disallow paths, block specific bots, and link a sitemap.

toolsPreview.name: word-counter
toolsPreview.description: Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in text, plus reading and speaking time.

toolsPreview.name: character-counter
toolsPreview.description: Count characters (with and without spaces), words, sentences, and paragraphs in text.

toolsPreview.name: readability-checker
toolsPreview.description: Score text readability with Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid Grade, plus a reading level.

toolsPreview.name: hreflang-generator
toolsPreview.description: Generate hreflang link tags for international/multilingual pages, plus an optional x-default.

toolsPreview.name: canonical-tag-generator
toolsPreview.description: Generate a rel=canonical link tag for a URL.

toolsPreview.name: meta-robots-generator
toolsPreview.description: Build a meta robots tag (and X-Robots-Tag header) from index/follow and snippet directives.

toolsPreview.name: sitemap-generator
toolsPreview.description: Build an XML sitemap from a list of URLs, with an optional lastmod date.

toolsPreview.name: robots-txt-tester
toolsPreview.description: Test whether a robots.txt allows or blocks a given URL path for a given user-agent.

toolsPreview.name: keyword-density-checker
toolsPreview.description: Analyze text for the most frequent words and phrases with their density, to spot keyword stuffing or thin coverage.

toolsPreview.name: headline-analyzer
toolsPreview.description: Score a headline (0-100) on length, word balance, power/emotional words, numbers, and brackets.

toolsPreview.name: slug-generator
toolsPreview.description: Turn a title into a clean, SEO-friendly URL slug: lowercase, hyphenated, accent-safe, optional stopword removal.

toolsPreview.name: utm-builder
toolsPreview.description: Append UTM tracking parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content) to a destination URL.

toolsPreview.name: ctr-calculator
toolsPreview.description: Calculate Click-through rate.

toolsPreview.name: conversion-rate-calculator
toolsPreview.description: Calculate Conversion rate.

toolsPreview.name: roas-calculator
toolsPreview.description: Calculate ROAS, ROAS (percentage).

toolsPreview.name: cpm-calculator
toolsPreview.description: Calculate Cost per 1,000 impressions (CPM).

toolsPreview.name: cpc-calculator
toolsPreview.description: Calculate Cost per click (CPC).

toolsPreview.name: ai-crawler-checker
toolsPreview.description: Check a robots.txt to see which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, ...) it currently allows or blocks.

toolsPreview.name: aeo-checker
toolsPreview.description: Score content (0-100) for how easily AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews) can quote it, with specific fixes.

toolsPreview.name: llms-txt-generator
toolsPreview.description: Generate an llms.txt file from a site name, one-line summary, optional details, and sections of links.

toolsPreview.name: ai-prompt-generator
toolsPreview.description: Generate prompts to test whether ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/Claude recommend a brand, and where it's invisible.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_domain
toolsPreview.description: Free, no-signup SEO snapshot for any domain: the queries it already ranks on page 1-2 for (its quick-win opportunities), with search volume and estimated traffic. Great first look before signing up.

toolsPreview.name: list_sites
toolsPreview.description: List the Spook sites on the account this API key belongs to, with each site's id, domain, autopilot state, and publishing setup. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: get_site
toolsPreview.description: Get one site's details and status by its id. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: list_opportunities
toolsPreview.description: The winnable search queries Spook has found for a site (scored, ranked). No cost. Pass questionsOnly to get only question-shaped queries. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: list_articles
toolsPreview.description: Recent articles for a site with their status (draft/review/published) and generation status. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: generate_article
toolsPreview.description: Generate a new SEO article draft for a site targeting a search query. Returns an articleId immediately; generation runs in the background - poll get_article/list_articles, or pass callbackUrl to be notified. Idempotent per query (a repeat returns the existing article). Requires an active subscription. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: get_article
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one article by id: full markdown body, meta, FAQs, SEO score, status, and published URL. Use to review a draft before publishing. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: get_site_metrics
toolsPreview.description: Read a site's performance: daily Search Console clicks/impressions trend plus cached SEO metrics (domain rating, organic traffic estimate, top keywords). No cost. Use to check whether Spook is working. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: create_site
toolsPreview.description: Add a new site to the account. Language/market is auto-detected from the homepage. Requires an available paid site slot (use create_checkout first if none). Returns the new siteId. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: update_publishing
toolsPreview.description: Configure where a site publishes. Set publishIntegration to 'nextjs' for a credential-free Spook-hosted blog (returns a blog API key), or 'webhook' with publishWebhookUrl. publishMode 'draft' or 'live'. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: create_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Get a Stripe Checkout URL to add the first paid site to the account. Return the URL to the user to approve payment. Needed before create_site if the account has no available slot. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: publish_article
toolsPreview.description: Publish a generated article to the site's connected CMS. Enforces Spook's SEO-score floor - a draft below it is refused (returns published:false with a reason). (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: set_autopilot
toolsPreview.description: Turn a site's autopilot on or off. When on, Spook plans, writes, and publishes articles automatically. (requires an agent API key)

toolsPreview.name: blog-keyword-generator
toolsPreview.description: Blog Keyword Generator: Generate SEO keyword ideas for a topic, with search intent and difficulty. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: content-brief-generator
toolsPreview.description: Content Brief Generator: Create a detailed SEO content brief for a target keyword. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: blog-outline-generator
toolsPreview.description: Blog Outline Generator: Produce a structured, SEO-friendly blog post outline. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: content-idea-generator
toolsPreview.description: Content Idea Generator: Generate content ideas with formats and angles for a niche. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: seo-title-generator
toolsPreview.description: SEO Title Generator: Write catchy, SEO-friendly title tags for a topic. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: meta-description-generator
toolsPreview.description: Meta Description Generator: Write SEO meta descriptions that maximize click-through rate. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: headline-generator
toolsPreview.description: Headline Generator: Generate catchy, click-worthy headlines. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: subject-line-generator
toolsPreview.description: Email Subject Line Generator: Write high-converting email subject lines. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: cta-generator
toolsPreview.description: CTA Generator: Write effective call-to-action phrases. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: ad-copy-generator
toolsPreview.description: Ad Copy Generator: Generate ad headlines and descriptions. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: social-post-generator
toolsPreview.description: Social Media Post Generator: Write platform-specific social media posts. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: article-summarizer
toolsPreview.description: AI Article Summarizer: Condense an article into a TL;DR, key points, and summary. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: article-rewriter
toolsPreview.description: AI Article Rewriter: Rephrase text to be clearer, unique, and engaging. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: grammar-checker
toolsPreview.description: AI Grammar Checker: Fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation, and list the corrections. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: faq-generator
toolsPreview.description: FAQ Generator: Generate a set of frequently asked questions and answers for a topic. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: product-description-generator
toolsPreview.description: Product Description Generator: Write persuasive product descriptions. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: business-name-generator
toolsPreview.description: Business Name Generator: Generate brandable business name ideas. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: youtube-title-generator
toolsPreview.description: YouTube Title & Description Generator: Write a YouTube title, description, and tags for a video topic. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: paragraph-generator
toolsPreview.description: Paragraph Generator: Expand a topic or sentence into a well-written paragraph. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: content-coverage-checker
toolsPreview.description: Content Coverage Checker: List the terms and entities an article targeting a keyword is expected to cover. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).

toolsPreview.name: hashtag-generator
toolsPreview.description: Hashtag Generator: Generate relevant hashtags for a topic and platform. (free, AI-generated, rate-limited).
